subject: AtlasHealth MSA & Order Form kickoff — redline queue
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Priya Gupta <p.gupta@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasHealth MSA & Order Form kickoff — redline queue

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for meeting yesterday — great to align on business scope. Attached are our starting drafts for the Master Services Agreement (MSA) and the Order Form. To help us prioritize the redline pass, can you confirm the following from your side?

- Primary signatory (name, title, email) and whether your legal team will mark up the Word or provide a PDF with comments.
- Desired residency/hosting region for production data (US-only / EU / multi-region).
- Preferred liability cap (you mentioned checking internally during the call).
- Billing contact and PO process (if different from signatory).
- Any non-standard compliance needs beyond SOC 2 (e.g., HITRUST, BAAs).

We typically return a first-pass redline within 5 business days from receipt of your marked-up document or list of priority clauses. If you need a faster turnaround for a narrow set of clauses (SLA, liability, or data residency) call that out and we’ll fast-track.

Attachments: Atlas_MSA_draft_v1.docx (editable), OrderForm_Atlas_v1.xlsx

Next steps: once you confirm the signatory and post any initial comments, I’ll loop Kimberly (contracts) and Neha (implementation) and we’ll kick off an internal triage.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Priya Gupta <p.gupta@atlashealth.com>

Cc: AtlasHealth Legal <legal@atlashealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasHealth MSA & Order Form kickoff — redline queue

Jordan — thanks, appreciated. Quick answers:

- Signatory: Priya Gupta, VP of Procurement (p.gupta@atlashealth.com). Our GC (Alex Law) will also be involved: alex.law@atlashealth.com.
- Hosting: US-only for now, but we need an option to add EU later.
- Liability cap: our procurement team prefers 12 months revenue or $1.5M cap — Alex will propose exact language.
- Billing/PO: billing@atlashealth.com; we use PO numbers on the invoice.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II is sufficient at this stage; we will route any additional requests via Alex.

We will send a PDF with comments from Alex by EOD tomorrow. Also can you share your SOC 2 report or a redacted summary?

Attached: none from our side yet — Alex will provide commentary and markups.

Priya
Priya Gupta
VP Procurement | AtlasHealth

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: AtlasHealth MSA & Order Form kickoff — redline queue

Jordan / Neha — I looked over the drafts. Initial internal playbook:

1) Prioritize: (a) Liability cap / indemnity; (b) Data residency + hosting region addendum; (c) SLA uptime language in Exhibit A; (d) Billing/PO flow in Order Form.
2) I will prepare a redline PDF with targeted edits for those sections and upload to the redline tracker.
3) If Atlas proposes a 12-month revenue cap, we should propose a 24-month carve with an exceptions table (exceptions: gross negligence, IP indemnity).
4) Need SOC 2 report link from them to fulfill security evidence request.

I’ve created a placeholder tracker: redline_tracker.csv — I’ll add clause owners and expected ETA (first pass by Fri 23 Jul). Jordan, please confirm whether we should offer a one-time commercial concession for revenue-based cap to expedite commercial sign-off.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Jordan here — quick answers: we can offer a one-time concession (reduce from 24 months to 18 months) if Atlas signs within the quarter, but want to preserve language for exclusions. I’ll also request SOC 2 link from you and Alex; if you can share the PDF or the audit center link that will speed evidence intake.

I’ll follow up with a HubSpot deal link and next steps for contracting cadence. ETA for our first-pass redline remains Fri 23 Jul unless you need us to narrow the scope for a 48-hour review.

Thanks,
Jordan
